newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 12.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Dec. 12:

WASHINGTON - In a decision that could cost 300 American banks hundreds of millions of dollars in federal taxes, the U.S. Tax Court has ruled that Brazilian officials concocted a "legal fiction" that provided tax write-offs for the banks in return for lower interest rates on loans to the Brazilian government.
NEW YORK - Investors unimpressed by Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan's stock price inflation worries last week apparently found a new excuse to dump stocks.
SINGAPORE - The 128-member governments of the World Trade Organisation have come to Singapore for their first general meeting, but are making scant progress.
WASHINGTON - Parents are paying experts to advise them on what school is best for their children and then to prepare their child for admission to that school.
